description: This file contains acceptance tests for the BasicModule in SuiteCRM, implemented using the Codeception framework. It defines a class BasicModuleCest with multiple test scenarios for creating, viewing, editing, duplicating, and deleting records within the module, utilizing various step objects to interact with the application's UI.
